email_body:
Dear Joske,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Intern position at HEIMWEE. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media, and SEO, I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to your three brands: MXDVS, Objects by Max Reynders, and Garments by Max Reynders.

In my current role at Episto, I create and publish content for client websites, manage social media integration, and track performance using analytics tools. I've also built and optimized my own project, mirook.com, where I've applied structured data and technical SEO to improve visibility. I'm comfortable with Instagram, TikTok, and content scheduling tools, and I'm eager to bring my proactive, organized approach to your team.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am happy to work on-site. I've attached my CV and a portfolio of content examples. I'd love to discuss how I can help bring your brands to life.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Joske,

I'm excited to apply for the Marketing Intern position at HEIMWEE. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web design, I'm drawn to the opportunity to work across your three distinct brands—MXDVS, Objects by Max Reynders, and Garments by Max Reynders—and to contribute to their growth through social media and content.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've gained hands-on experience in planning and creating content, managing WordPress sites, and analyzing performance data. I write keyword-targeted blog posts, optimize on-page SEO, and use tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush to track results. I've also developed my own project, mirook.com, where I've implemented structured data and technical SEO to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This has taught me how to translate brand identity into content that resonates with audiences.

I'm comfortable creating photo and video content for Instagram and TikTok, and I'm familiar with content calendars and scheduling tools. I'm proactive, organized, and enjoy working in small, collaborative teams where everyone's input matters. I'm fluent in English and based in Zwijndrecht, so I'm happy to work on-site.

I'm particularly drawn to HEIMWEE's multi-brand approach, and I'm eager to learn how marketing strategies differ across fashion and furniture. I'd love to bring my creativity and technical skills to your team and help your brands shine.

Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my CV and portfolio, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
